name: Gate Pass
summary: A boarding pass check-in: a 6-character booking code builds a barcode, then the plane takes off
about: A paper boarding pass from Karachi to Islamabad under a drifting dawn sky (a starry night in dark mode). Each letter or number of the booking reference adds its own group of bars to the barcode; a red laser scans it, a CHECKED IN stamp lands and the plane flies the route arc with a puffy trail. Good for travel, event tickets and any letters-and-numbers reference code.
how: Type the booking reference shown on the pass (letters and numbers), or paste it; backspace and arrows move between cells
Every character grows a new group of bars in the barcode
After the sixth character a laser sweeps the barcode while it is checked
A right code turns the bars green, stamps CHECKED IN and flies the plane from KHI to ISB
A wrong code turns the bars red and clears the cells; Check in another passenger starts a new pass
